DrMundo.combo: When Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is down, engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, hitting a unit, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. If you have a kill opportunity, build Fury, engage, then use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice. If his passive is still available, it ignores the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator, so don’t take a fight relying on that combo.
DrMundo.build: Build armor first to withstand the physical damage from Dr. Mundo E Blunt Force Trauma. If Dr. Mundo’s healing negates the damage from a short trade, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
DrMundo.escape: When Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is down and his passive is unavailable, close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Dr. Mundo has no ability to create distance on his own, but the first dash must hit a unit to let you escape with the second, so choose your target before engaging.
DrMundo.fight: Build Fury before fighting so you can use Renekton P Reign of Anger. After Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw is blocked by a minion or used, get on him with Renekton E Slice and Dice, deal brief damage, then disengage. If you need sustain, empower Renekton Q Cull the Meek to hit both Dr. Mundo and minions.
DrMundo.laning: If Dr. Mundo’s passive canister drops, step on it along your retreat path to deny his healing and passive cooldown reduction.
DrMundo.phase: Turn your lead through the mid game, as your core items come online, into lane pressure and objectives, and look to force a fight while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is down. Renekton’s value falls off late, so avoid fights that keep you tied up with Dr. Mundo for a long time.
DrMundo.teamfight: Don’t spend time trying to kill Dr. Mundo while Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active; target a key enemy damage dealer from the flank. Just before engaging, activate Renekton R Dominus, secure an exit with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator and escape.
DrMundo.watch: Dr. Mundo Q Infected Bonesaw hits only the first target it strikes and deals more damage when your current health is high, so stand behind minions. If Dr. Mundo P Goes Where He Pleases is available, it ignores the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator, so don’t engage assuming the stun will work before the passive is down. While Dr. Mundo R Maximum Dosage is active, account for its healing and movement speed increase; don’t force a kill.

Kled.laning: Keep your Fury near half with minion last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don't keep pushing the lane just to build Fury. If you've dismounted Kled, push him out of lane so he can't build courage by killing minions. If you're caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope and have no way out, move toward a minion wave or your allies.
Kled.build: Kled's main damage is physical, so get Plated Steelcaps earlier. If trades keep going poorly, buy Chain Vest first; if the enemy team has several physical damage dealers, consider Randuin's Omen as well. Armor won't block the magic damage from Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!!, and Kled W Violent Tendencies and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! deal damage based on your maximum health, so avoid building only health.
Kled.combo: Hit a minion or Kled with Renekton E Slice and Dice to secure the recast, then trade and disengage with basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice. If you have a kill opportunity and Fury is ready, use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice to burst him.
Kled.escape: Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope gives you a chance to escape just after it catches you, before the pull, so use Renekton E Slice and Dice then. Decide whether to engage based on whether Kled E Jousting and Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! have been used, especially targeting the window before Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! comes back up. Use Renekton E Slice and Dice to close the gap during that window, then stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator.
Kled.fight: Engage after dodging Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope or Kled W Violent Tendencies, and back off after using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice until they're ready again. If Kled is dismounted, check his courage bar to judge whether you can finish him.
Kled.phase: Turn your lead by mid game into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton's combat value falls later, and Kled also weakens after the laning phase and mid game, so don't drag fights out on the assumption that you'll have a late-game advantage.
Kled.teamfight: Secure flank vision because Kled R Chaaaaaaaarge!!! can engage from far away. If you can't stop the engage beforehand, hold your formation, since he charges the first champion in his path. From the flank, Renekton should hit an enemy carry with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then use Renekton E Slice and Dice to escape using the setup secured before engaging.
Kled.watch: If caught by Kled Q Bear Trap on a Rope, create distance with Renekton E Slice and Dice before you're pulled in. When Kled W Violent Tendencies is active, back off before the fourth basic attack hits, then re-engage. Dismounted Kled can remount Skaarl once his courage fills, so if you can't finish him, create distance to reduce his opportunities to build courage.

Kennen.watch: Three stacks of Kennen P Mark of the Storm stun you, so if you've been hit twice, back off and wait for the stacks to expire. Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom can lead to area damage and a stun, so don't group up with your team when Kennen engages.
Kennen.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Kennen deals mostly magic damage, and Renekton's magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first.
Kennen.combo: Your standard trade is to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek, and disengage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and you have a kill opportunity, build Fury, then use engage → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Kennen.escape: Engage when Kennen E Lightning Rush is down and Kennen P Mark of the Storm stacks have expired. Hit a minion or Kennen with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to keep the recast available so you can escape after trading.
Kennen.fight: Build Fury ahead of time, then close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice after Kennen E Lightning Rush is down. Once you're on him, stun with Renekton W Ruthless Predator; when you need sustain, trade with an empowered Renekton Q Cull the Meek for healing.
Kennen.laning: Kennen Q Thundering Shuriken hits only the first target, so stand behind minions and step out only briefly to last-hit. Build Fury with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek without constantly pushing the lane. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don't stand aggressively until both are back up.
Kennen.phase: Renekton's value falls later, while Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom's area stun remains a teamfight threat.
Kennen.teamfight: Use vision to block Kennen R Slicing Maelstrom's engage angles, and spread out from your team. From the flank, Renekton should hit an enemy carry with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice.

Akali.escape: Don’t rush in when only one of Akali W Twilight Shroud or Akali E Shuriken Flip is down; she can escape with the other mobility tool. In particular, close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator before Akali R Perfect Execution comes off cooldown.
Akali.teamfight: Plan when to activate Renekton R Dominus and where to set up an exit with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then engage from the flank. Use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer and escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If the enemy frontline is too strong, don’t force your way through; target the backline.
Akali.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali deals mostly magic damage, and Renekton has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Akali.combo: Your basic trade is to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek, then disengage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. You can recast the first Renekton E Slice and Dice only if it hits a unit, so choose your target before engaging.
Akali.fight: When Akali comes out of Akali W Twilight Shroud to attack, or misses Akali E Shuriken Flip, close in with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Disengage with Renekton E Slice and Dice after the trade, and don’t position aggressively until Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice are back up.
Akali.laning: Keep Fury near half with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don’t keep hitting minions in a way that pushes the lane. If you have to fight inside Akali W Twilight Shroud, hit her with Renekton Q Cull the Meek during the brief moment she becomes visible, or draw the fight near a turret.
Akali.phase: Renekton’s value falls off late, and he is at a disadvantage if fights drag on after his combo, so make use of your early lead.

Camille.phase: Camille is at her weakest before her first core item, so turn your lead during this window into lane pressure and objectives. From mid game onward, Camille can quickly take down turrets in a side lane, so don’t leave a lane unattended. Renekton’s value falls off late, so avoid extended fights.
Camille.build: Build Plated Steelcaps early to withstand Camille’s main damage, and if you keep losing trades, get armor with Chain Vest. Armor doesn’t reduce the true damage from Camille Q Precision Protocol, and Camille W Tactical Sweep scales with your maximum health, so avoid choices that add only a lot of health. If healing from Camille W Tactical Sweep negates your combo damage, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Camille.combo: Use the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to hit a minion or Camille and unlock the recast, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. For a kill, build Fury and use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Camille.escape: After Camille E Hookshot’s stun and dash are used, close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and pin her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum is down too, she has less room to escape with a mobility ability. Before engaging, choose what the first Renekton E Slice and Dice dash will hit so you have the recast for your escape.
Camille.fight: If Camille P Adaptive Defenses’ shield is still up, break it and deal damage with an empowered hit from Renekton W Ruthless Predator.
Camille.laning: Build Fury with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don’t keep pushing the lane and exposing yourself to ganks. Take control before Camille completes her first core item to disrupt her farming, and avoid positions where you can be pinned toward a wall.
Camille.teamfight: From the flank, use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer and escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, check what the first dash will hit and your escape route, and plan when to activate Renekton R Dominus. If Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum traps you, don’t waste your response ability when she engages; wait out the zone’s duration, then counterattack.
Camille.watch: Camille E Hookshot uses walls to engage from far away and stun you, so stand among minions away from walls. When Camille R The Hextech Ultimatum engages, don’t use your response ability immediately; first dodge Camille E Hookshot or Camille W Tactical Sweep.

Gnar.build: Build armor first against Gnar’s main damage, and buy Plated Steelcaps early if his poke is strong. If you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first; if the enemy team has several physical damage dealers, build it into Randuin’s Omen. Gnar W Hyper / Wallop deals magic damage based on your max health, so armor or health alone won’t block all the damage.
Gnar.combo: Once Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down, engage with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice through a minion or Gnar, then basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. If you see a chance to kill, build Fury and use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Gnar.escape: The moment after Gnar E Hop / Crunch is down is your window to go in with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Avoid engaging near walls while Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! is a threat, and look for the moment he changes back to Mini Gnar. Before engaging, choose a unit to hit with Renekton E Slice and Dice’s first dash so you can escape with the recast.
Gnar.fight: Build Fury ahead of time while Gnar is in Mini Gnar form. Right after you make him use Gnar E Hop / Crunch, close in with Renekton E Slice and Dice and lock him down with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Don’t fight Mega Gnar right after he transforms; create distance and wait for the transformation to end. Just after he changes from Mega Gnar back to Mini Gnar, go all in during the window when he can’t transform again.
Gnar.laning: After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don’t stand aggressively until both skills are back up.
Gnar.phase: Renekton struggles in long fights after his combo and loses value late, so keep fights short while you have the advantage.
Gnar.teamfight: Avoid positions with a wall behind you and narrow terrain so Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! can’t knock you into a wall and stun you. Just after Mega Gnar changes back to Mini Gnar, use the window when he can’t transform again to start a fight with your team. Flank and use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer, then get out with Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Gnar.watch: Gnar Q Boomerang Throw / Boulder Toss can hit you both on the way out and on the way back while he’s in Mini Gnar form, so step out of its path. Mega Gnar’s Gnar R GNAR! stuns enemies who hit a wall and deals extra damage, so avoid angles with your back to a wall. When his transformation is close, avoid direct fights and create distance.

Quinn.fight: Start trades just after Quinn E Vault is used or when your jungler arrives. Build Fury ahead of time, close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. After the trade, escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice and don't stand aggressively until your abilities are back up.
Quinn.build: Quinn's main damage is physical, so build armor. Get Plated Steelcaps early, and if you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first to hold on. If the enemy team has several physical damage dealers, build toward Randuin's Omen as well.
Quinn.combo: When Quinn E Vault is down, engage by hitting a unit with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then trade in this order: basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice. If you have Fury and a kill opportunity, after engaging use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice. After level 6, activate Renekton R Dominus just before engaging.
Quinn.escape: The moment after Quinn E Vault is used is your chance to engage while she has no escape. Hit a minion or Quinn with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to unlock its recast, then go in. After the trade, escape with the saved dash.
Quinn.laning: Build Fury through last-hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don't keep pushing the lane. Farm while Quinn P Harrier's mark is absent, and look to engage after Quinn E Vault is down.
Quinn.teamfight: If Quinn approaches from the flank, stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and choose an escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice before engaging. Don't let the fight drag on after your combo.
Quinn.watch: Quinn E Vault knocks Renekton back and marks him, so don't force an engage while it is available. If Quinn P Harrier marks you, move out of basic attack range and let the mark expire. Stand behind your minion wave to make Quinn Q Blinding Assault hit the minions first.

Chogath.combo: After Cho'Gath Q Rupture or Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is down, trade with Renekton E Slice and Dice → basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice. If you expect to lose the trade, skip the first basic attack and disengage quickly.
Chogath.escape: Engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice after dodging Cho'Gath Q Rupture or while Cho'Gath W Feral Scream is down. Cho'Gath has no mobility, so once you're on him, lock him down with Renekton W Ruthless Predator and trade. Your first Renekton E Slice and Dice must hit a unit to unlock the recast, so pick a target to hit before engaging, then use the second cast to escape after the combo.
Chogath.fight: If you need sustain, spend Fury on empowered Renekton Q Cull the Meek; if you have a kill window, spend it on empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator.
Chogath.teamfight: Rather than staying in front and soaking damage for long, Renekton should approach from the side and land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer. Before engaging, decide when to activate Renekton R Dominus and plan a route to escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Disengage with Renekton E Slice and Dice after your combo, since you lack sustained damage.
Chogath.build: Cho'Gath Q Rupture, W Feral Scream, and E Vorpal Spikes deal mostly magic damage, so start by surviving with Null-Magic Mantle. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Cho'Gath P Carnivore’s healing negates one Renekton combo, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Chogath.laning: Keep Fury near half with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don’t keep hitting minions to build Fury and push the lane too far. Cho'Gath E Vorpal Spikes pass through minions, so step out of the line when Cho'Gath is basic attacking. Immediately after Cho'Gath uses Q Rupture on the wave, pressure him or look for a jungle gank to limit his time to scale.
Chogath.phase: Turn the lead you have gained by the mid game into lane pressure and objective fights. Cho'Gath gets stronger over time while Renekton’s late game value falls off, so keep Cho'Gath suppressed early.
Chogath.watch: When the warning for Cho'Gath Q Rupture appears under you, dodge to the side and save Renekton E Slice and Dice for that moment. Cho'Gath W Feral Scream silences you from the front and prevents movement, so circle around to fight. If you’re at half health or below, create distance to avoid the true damage from Cho'Gath R Feast.

Fiora.watch: Fiora W Riposte blocks attacks and immobilizing effects. If it blocks the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator, it stuns you instead. Hold Renekton W Ruthless Predator while Fiora W Riposte is available, and move sideways when using key abilities to dodge her counterattack. Fiora moves toward the vital on the side of Fiora P Duelist's Dance, so stand on the opposite side to limit her attack angle.
Fiora.build: Build Plated Steelcaps early and prioritize armor to withstand the physical damage from Fiora Q Lunge and Fiora E Bladework. If you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first. If Fiora’s healing negates your short combo damage, buy Executioner's Calling between core items. Armor doesn’t help against the true damage from Fiora P Duelist's Dance and Fiora R Grand Challenge. Fiora R Grand Challenge deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t stack only health.
Fiora.combo: Once you confirm Fiora W Riposte is down, engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. For a kill, build Fury, then use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Fiora.escape: Right after you make Fiora use Q Lunge, you have an opportunity to close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Fiora W Riposte is down too, stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, attack briefly, then escape with the recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice. To disengage, the first dash must hit a minion or Fiora.
Fiora.fight: Engage when Fiora Q Lunge or Fiora W Riposte is down, and if Fiora W Riposte is still available, don’t lead with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Don’t overcommit to chasing after the trade.
Fiora.laning: Build close to half your Fury and stand opposite the vital, then counterattack when Fiora moves toward that side. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don’t position aggressively until both are back up.
Fiora.phase: Turn your lead through the mid game, as your core items come online, into lane pressure and objective fights.
Fiora.teamfight: When Fiora R Grand Challenge hits you, stand against a wall to block one side of the vitals. Keep moving so you don’t give her all four vitals, which would heal Fiora and nearby allies. Renekton should flank and use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Fiora W Riposte is available, don’t use your stun first.

KSante.escape: Engage after dodging K'Sante W Path Maker's charge and dash, or after the dangerous next cast of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes has been used. If you engage just because K'Sante E Footwork is down, he can escape with another mobility ability, so look for a window when multiple mobility abilities are down, especially before K'Sante R All Out comes back up. Close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice, lock him down with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then escape using the recast unlocked when your first Renekton E hits a unit.
KSante.fight: Build Fury in advance with minion last hits, then trade briefly after the dangerous next cast of K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes has been used or K'Sante W Path Maker is down. If K'Sante tries to hold out with the shield from K'Sante E Footwork, break it by hitting him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator empowered by Renekton P Reign of Anger. When K'Sante R All Out is active, focus your damage on his reduced defenses, but don't fight alone for long while facing his increased damage and lifesteal.
KSante.build: Build armor against K'Sante P Dauntless Instinct and K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes, along with his other physical damage. If trades keep going poorly, buy Chain Vest first; if physical damage is high, get Plated Steelcaps earlier. If the enemy team has several physical damage dealers, get armor and health with Randuin's Omen.
KSante.combo: If K'Sante's crowd control is down and there's a unit for the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to hit, take a short trade: E engage → basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → E disengage. If you're targeting K'Sante E Footwork's shield or have a kill opportunity, build Fury first, then concentrate your damage with E engage → empowered W → Q → basic attack → E. After level 6, activate Renekton R Dominus just before engaging.
KSante.laning: Keep your Fury near half with minion last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don't keep pushing the lane to build Fury and expose yourself to ganks.
KSante.phase: It's hard to recover lane control once K'Sante has built defensive items, so turn your lead by mid game, when Renekton is strong, into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton's value falls later, and he's at a disadvantage in a prolonged fight after his combo, so choose engagements that can end the fight at once.
KSante.teamfight: Instead of forcing your way through K'Sante's thick frontline, flank and hit an enemy carry with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, plan both your E escape setup and when to activate Renekton R Dominus. If K'Sante R All Out is active, focus your team's damage on his reduced defenses, but if the fight will last, make sure at least one teammate has healing reduction and don't let K'Sante keep hitting multiple targets.
KSante.watch: If you've been hit by K'Sante Q Ntofo Strikes in succession or K'Sante has built stacks on minions, watch for the next Q pull and stun: move out of range or save Renekton E Slice and Dice. If you see K'Sante W Path Maker charging, save Renekton W Ruthless Predator until its unstoppable effect and damage reduction end, and sidestep the direction of the dash. Check the terrain behind you during a standoff so K'Sante R All Out can't push you over a wall.

Trundle.build: Build armor first to withstand Trundle Q Chomp and his basic attacks. Trundle R Subjugate deals damage based on your maximum health and reduces your resistances, so prioritize getting out of its range over stacking more health or resistances. If Trundle's healing offsets the damage from Renekton's short combos, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Trundle.combo: Build Fury and engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, hitting a unit, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to escape. When you have a kill opportunity, unload damage with Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice. After level 6, activate Renekton R Dominus just before engaging.
Trundle.escape: Engage when Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down and you are outside Trundle W Frozen Domain's area. Trundle has no skill to create distance on his own, so close in with Renekton E Slice and Dice and use Renekton W Ruthless Predator. When engaging, choose a unit for the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to hit so you can recast it to escape.
Trundle.fight: Take a short fight after Trundle Q Chomp's attack damage reduction ends and you have moved out of Trundle W Frozen Domain. If Trundle E Pillar of Ice is down, approach in open terrain with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. After your combo, do not fight for long; escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Trundle.laning: Build Fury with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but do not push the lane too far. Trundle P King's Tribute restores his health, so if your poke succeeds, take an advantage immediately or push the lane to force him to recall.
Trundle.teamfight: Renekton should flank and land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on an enemy carry, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, check your escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice and when to activate Renekton R Dominus.
Trundle.watch: Trundle Q Chomp reduces your attack damage, so stop trading until the effect ends. Do not fight inside Trundle W Frozen Domain; back out of it. Trundle E Pillar of Ice blocks your escape, so avoid narrow paths and immediately sidestep when the pillar appears. Keep your distance while Trundle R Subjugate is active.

Aatrox.build: Build Plated Steelcaps early and get armor to withstand the physical damage from Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade and Aatrox W Infernal Chains. If you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first. If his healing negates your combo damage, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Aatrox.combo: If Aatrox E Umbral Dash is down, engage with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice, hitting a unit, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → recast Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. If you have a kill opportunity and enough Fury, engage and deal your damage with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Aatrox.escape: Engage immediately after Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade has been fully spent or Aatrox E Umbral Dash has been used. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains is still available, hit a unit with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice so you can recast it, and keep a way to leave the area if the chains catch you.
Aatrox.fight: Build up close to half your Fury, then take a short trade immediately after Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade has been fully spent. Immediately after Aatrox uses E Umbral Dash, close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. If Aatrox R World Ender is active, create distance and wait out its duration.
Aatrox.laning: Build Fury with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but avoid pushing the lane too far and exposing yourself to ganks. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don’t position aggressively until both are back up.
Aatrox.phase: Renekton is strong through the mid game as his core items come online, so turn your lead into lane pressure and objectives. His value falls off late, and he is at a disadvantage if fights drag on after his combo, so look for short fights.
Aatrox.teamfight: Plan when to activate Renekton R Dominus and where to set up an exit with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then engage from the flank. Use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer and escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Aatrox.watch: Aatrox Q The Darkin Blade is his main source of damage, so watch the cast and dodge beyond the blade’s tip or move in close. If Aatrox W Infernal Chains hits you, leave its area immediately. Aatrox R World Ender increases his healing, so avoid dueling while it is active.

Aurora.build: Survive the early game with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurora deals mostly magic damage, and Renekton has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. If Aurora P Spirit Abjuration’s healing negates your combo damage, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Aurora.combo: Your basic trade is to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek, then disengage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. You can recast it only if the first dash hits a minion or Aurora, so choose your target before engaging. For a kill, build Fury, then use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Aurora.escape: Make Aurora use Aurora E The Weirding, then look for your next engage, and check whether Aurora W Across the Veil is down too. Close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator.
Aurora.fight: Build close to half your Fury and take short trades right after Aurora’s poke ability is used. If you need sustain, hit both minions and Aurora with Renekton Q Cull the Meek to heal. If you have a kill opportunity, stun her with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Don’t waste abilities while Aurora W Across the Veil makes her invisible; wait for her to reappear.
Aurora.laning: Keep an eye on the lane state: constantly hitting minions to build Fury pushes the lane and exposes you to ganks. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don’t position aggressively until both are back up.
Aurora.phase: Turn the lead you build through the mid game, as your core items come online, into lane pressure and objectives. You are at a disadvantage if fights drag on after your combo and fall off late, so make use of your early and mid game opportunities.
Aurora.teamfight: From the flank, use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on Aurora or a key enemy damage dealer, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, plan what the first dash will hit and when to activate Renekton R Dominus. If Aurora jumps in and fails to kill anyone, that’s an opening to catch her. When retreating, don’t leave low health allies behind.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, leave the line between you and Aurora before the curse returns. The return damage increases based on your missing health, so back off when you’re low. When Aurora R Between Worlds creates its zone, you’re slowed when leaving it, and Aurora can cross to the other side, so don’t chase her directly.

Darius.build: Build Plated Steelcaps early to withstand Darius’s physical damage, and if you keep losing trades, survive with Chain Vest. Darius E Apprehend ignores some armor and Darius R Noxian Guillotine deals true damage, so secure health too instead of relying only on armor. If healing from Darius Q Decimate negates your short combo damage, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Darius.combo: When Darius E Apprehend is down, engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, hitting a unit to unlock the recast, then trade with basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice. If staying close is dangerous, skip the first basic attack and finish quickly with Renekton E Slice and Dice → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice. For a kill, build Fury and use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Darius.escape: Engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice when Darius E Apprehend misses or is on cooldown. The first dash must hit a minion or Darius to unlock the second dash so you can escape after the trade. The window while Darius R Noxian Guillotine is down is also an opening, but keep a mobility option available to answer Darius E Apprehend.
Darius.fight: Right after Darius E Apprehend misses or is used, engage briefly with Fury ready. Stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, hit him with Renekton Q Cull the Meek, then disengage with Renekton E Slice and Dice to avoid an extended fight that builds Darius P Hemorrhage stacks. The moment after Darius uses Q Decimate to clear minions is also a chance to pressure him.
Darius.laning: Use Renekton Q Cull the Meek where it can hit Darius and minions together to get the healing. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don’t position aggressively until both are back up.
Darius.phase: Renekton’s value falls off late, and he struggles in extended fights, so focus on short combos.
Darius.teamfight: Use the bonus health and Fury from Renekton R Dominus to flank and hit a key enemy damage dealer with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Before engaging, plan an exit with Renekton E Slice and Dice, and don’t stay long after your combo. If Darius P Hemorrhage has stacked several times while you’re still in the fight, Darius R Noxian Guillotine can secure a kill and reset, so create full distance.
Darius.watch: If Darius E Apprehend pulls you in, he follows with a basic attack, Darius W Crippling Strike, and Darius Q Decimate, so poke from outside its range. When Darius Q Decimate appears, move outside the blade’s edge or hug him to reduce its damage and healing. If Darius P Hemorrhage stacks build up, create distance to drop them. If health has decreased while the stacks are still present, move completely out of range of Darius R Noxian Guillotine.

Gangplank.build: If the physical damage from Gangplank Q Parrrley and Gangplank E Powder Keg is too much, buy Plated Steelcaps early. If you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first. Gangplank P Trial by Fire and Gangplank R Cannon Barrage deal true damage that resistances can’t reduce, so build some health too. If Gangplank W Remove Scurvy’s healing offsets your combo damage, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Gangplank.combo: Your standard trade is Renekton E Slice and Dice to engage → basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. For a kill, build Fury and wait until Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down, then use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Gangplank.escape: Gangplank has no ability to create distance on his own, so when he has just placed or lost Gangplank E Powder Keg, you have a chance to go in with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Delay your engage if you’d be in range of Gangplank E Powder Keg’s slow or near a primed keg. If you need to stun him and keep him there, use Renekton W Ruthless Predator after Gangplank W Remove Scurvy is down.
Gangplank.fight: Build Fury to around half with last hits and basic attacks, then close in with Renekton E Slice and Dice when Gangplank has just placed Gangplank E Powder Keg or right after you destroy a nearby keg. If you need sustain, use empowered Renekton Q Cull the Meek to hit both minions and Gangplank. If you see a chance to kill, spend Fury on empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Keep in mind that Gangplank W Remove Scurvy can remove Renekton W Ruthless Predator’s stun if it’s still available.
Gangplank.laning: Destroy Gangplank E Powder Keg from outside its blast radius, and avoid fighting near a primed keg. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don’t stand aggressively until both skills are back up.
Gangplank.phase: Turn the advantage you gain through the mid game core-item stage into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton’s value falls off late, and he struggles in long fights, so don’t prolong the fight after your combo.
Gangplank.teamfight: Avoid spots where two Gangplank E Powder Kegs overlap, and track whether Gangplank R Cannon Barrage has been used to choose when to fight for objectives. Flank and use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer, then get out with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, choose your escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice and decide when to activate Renekton R Dominus.
Gangplank.watch: Gangplank Q Parrrley chips away at your health in lane, and Gangplank E Powder Keg explodes and slows you. When Gangplank has just placed Gangplank E Powder Keg, you have a chance to trade, but back off from a primed keg or a spot where two kegs overlap.

Garen.build: Buy Plated Steelcaps early against the physical damage from Garen Q Decisive Strike and Garen E Judgment. If you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first. Garen E Judgment reduces your armor, so leave its spin range even if you’ve built armor. Garen R Demacian Justice can’t be reduced by armor, so build some health too. If Garen P Perseverance’s healing offsets your combo damage, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Garen.combo: Start your combo after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack is spent and Garen W Courage’s brief shield and tenacity window has passed. Use Renekton E Slice and Dice to engage through a unit, then basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. If you see a chance to kill, build up Fury, stun him with empowered W, then use Q and a basic attack before retreating with E.
Garen.fight: Engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, use Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, then retreat with E. If Garen has activated Garen W Courage, delay W by half a beat. Don’t stay close and fight for long while Garen E Judgment is spinning.
Garen.laning: Deal damage in short bursts so Garen P Perseverance’s healing doesn’t reverse the trade. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don’t stand aggressively until both skills are back up.
Garen.phase: Turn the advantage you gain in lane and objective fights through the mid game, as your core items come online, into pressure. Garen gets stronger as Garen W Courage’s growth stacks build, while Renekton’s value falls off late, so put him behind early.
Garen.teamfight: Rather than staying in front and soaking damage, approach from the flank and use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer. After your combo, you have no sustained damage, so get out with E.
Garen.watch: Garen Q Decisive Strike’s empowered attack applies silence and prevents you from fighting back, so don’t engage first while Garen has it available. Garen E Judgment punishes you for staying close, so use Renekton E Slice and Dice to get out of its spin range. Garen gains a shield and tenacity right after Garen W Courage, so delay Renekton W Ruthless Predator by half a beat. If you’re below half health, watch out for Garen R Demacian Justice, which deals true damage based on your missing health, and stay out of its range.
Garen.escape: The moment after Garen Q Decisive Strike’s silence-inflicting basic attack is spent is your chance to go in with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Garen has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you engage, keep him there with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Your first E must hit a minion or Garen to unlock the recast, so choose a foothold for your escape before going in.

Gwen.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Prioritize magic resistance against Gwen’s main magic damage, but reposition to avoid the center’s true damage from Gwen Q Snip Snip! If Gwen’s healing offsets the damage from one combo, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Gwen.combo: Once Gwen E Skip ’n Slash is down, engage through a unit with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. If you see a favorable fight, build Fury and unload damage with E engage → empowered W → Q → basic attack → E.
Gwen.escape: Gwen E Skip ’n Slash is her mobility tool, so close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice right after she uses it and keep her there with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. If Gwen R Needlework’s slow has ended, there’s less risk of it disrupting your engage or escape. Before engaging, choose a unit to hit with Renekton E Slice and Dice’s first dash so you have the recast available.
Gwen.fight: Trade briefly before Gwen Q Snip Snip! builds stacks and right after Gwen E Skip ’n Slash is down. Build Fury ahead of time, engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! as you disengage. Renekton is at a disadvantage if the trade drags on, so don’t stay close after using your skills.
Gwen.laning: Build Fury with minion last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek without pushing the lane too far. Gwen can heal when she basic attacks you, so stay outside her basic attack range except when trading.
Gwen.phase: Renekton loses value late and struggles in long fights, so focus on short engages.
Gwen.teamfight: Activate Renekton R Dominus as you engage, check that you have an escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice, then approach from the flank. Use Renekton W Ruthless Predator’s empowered stun on a key enemy damage dealer and get out with E. Avoid the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip! and the area damage from Gwen R Needlework, and don’t prolong the fight.
Gwen.watch: The true damage in the center of Gwen Q Snip Snip!’s cone is dangerous, so move sideways to avoid the center. While Gwen W Hallowed Mist is active, you can’t target Gwen from outside the mist, so either enter it or wait for it to end. Watch out for the slow and max-health-based damage from Gwen R Needlework too.

Illaoi.build: Illaoi’s main damage is physical, so buy Plated Steelcaps early and build armor first. If you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first. If Illaoi’s healing offsets your combo damage, fit Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Illaoi.combo: Before engaging, choose a minion or Illaoi to hit with Renekton E Slice and Dice’s first dash so you have the recast available. If Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down, make a short trade with Renekton E Slice and Dice to engage → basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage.
Illaoi.escape: Engage right after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit or right after Illaoi W Harsh Lesson is down. Hit a unit with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to keep the second dash available, then use it to escape after your combo.
Illaoi.fight: Right after dodging Illaoi E Test of Spirit or making her use Illaoi W Harsh Lesson, fight briefly with Fury already built up. Close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice, stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then use Renekton Q Cull the Meek for damage and healing before disengaging.
Illaoi.laning: Keep the lane away from walls and last-hit from outside Illaoi E Test of Spirit’s range. Build Fury with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek without continually pushing the lane. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don’t stand aggressively until both skills are back up.
Illaoi.phase: Turn the advantage you gain through the mid game, as your core items come online, into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton loses value late and falls behind if the fight drags on after his combo, so focus on short engages.
Illaoi.teamfight: Destroy Illaoi’s tentacles if you can; if you can’t, draw her out into open ground away from walls. Don’t group up in front of Illaoi R Leap of Faith; spread out and wait out its short duration. Flank and use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer, then escape with the recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Illaoi.watch: If Illaoi E Test of Spirit hits you, its slow and mark put you under pressure, so stand out of range when last-hitting and dodge it if she casts it. Illaoi R Leap of Faith concentrates her damage over a short time, so create distance when she uses it and don’t fight near tentacles.

Irelia.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia W Defiant Dance. If Irelia Q Bladesurge’s healing reverses the trade, buy Executioner’s Calling between core items.
Irelia.combo: Build Fury, then engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice and use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Irelia.fight: Right after Irelia Q Bladesurge, close in with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Build Fury ahead of time, deal damage briefly, and retreat. Don’t extend the fight after using your skills until they’re ready again.
Irelia.phase: Turn Renekton’s advantage through mid game into lane pressure and objectives. His value falls off late, so avoid long fights.
Irelia.teamfight: Prioritize Irelia before she can take over teamfights with Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge and Irelia E Flawless Duet. Activate Renekton R Dominus as you engage, stun her with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then get out with the recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain dashes to low-health minions to close the distance, so keep away when minions are close to dying. Avoid the stun from Irelia E Flawless Duet. If you’re trapped inside Irelia R Vanguard’s Edge, wait until the blades disappear.

Jax.build: Jax’s basic attacks and attack speed are the core of his damage, so prioritize ways to reduce his attack speed. Jax Q Leap Strike deals physical damage, while Jax W Empower and Jax E Counter Strike deal magic damage, so consider both armor and magic resistance. Jax E Counter Strike deals damage based on your max health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health.
Jax.combo: After Jax E Counter Strike ends, choose a unit to hit and engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek, then disengage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. For a kill, build Fury and use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Jax.escape: The window to engage is right after Jax Q Leap Strike and while Jax E Counter Strike is down. Close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, but hit a unit with the first dash to keep the recast for your escape.
Jax.fight: Build Fury and trade briefly after Jax E Counter Strike is down. If Counter Strike is active, save Renekton E Slice and Dice as a way to back off, and use Renekton Q Cull the Meek to deal damage with an ability.
Jax.laning: Build Fury with minion last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek without pushing the lane too far. While Jax E Counter Strike is down, pressure him with your jungler to build a CS and level lead.
Jax.phase: Use Renekton’s strong period through mid game, and avoid fights that drag on after your combo late game.
Jax.teamfight: If Jax jumps in with Jax E Counter Strike active, don’t group around him; wait for the area stun to end. Then stun a key enemy damage dealer with Renekton W Ruthless Predator and get out with Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Jax.watch: Don’t use Renekton W Ruthless Predator or basic attacks while Jax E Counter Strike is active. Your attacks are negated, and the recast damage can increase, so step outside its stun range and wait for Counter Strike to end.

Jayce.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first early on, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first against Jayce’s main damage, but keep in mind the physical damage from Jayce Q To the Skies! / Shock Blast. Jayce E Thundering Blow / Acceleration Gate deals damage based on your max health, so don’t rely on choices that only add a lot of health.
Jayce.combo: Once Jayce’s mobility or knockback is down, engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice and trade with basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice, then disengage. For a kill, build Fury and attack with Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice. Your first E must hit a unit to be recast, so choose your target and escape route before engaging.
Jayce.escape: Right after you make Jayce use the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! is your chance to close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is down too, engage and stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator.
Jayce.fight: Build Fury before trading so you can use Renekton P Reign of Anger. After Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap or Jayce E Thundering Blow’s knockback is down, close in with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. If you need sustain, use Renekton Q Cull the Meek where minions and Jayce overlap.
Jayce.laning: Build Fury with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don’t keep pushing the lane and exposing yourself to ganks. Trade after Jayce’s poke abilities are down. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, back off until both skills are ready again.
Jayce.phase: Jayce is strong early, so farm and hold on if you fall behind rather than forcing a comeback. Renekton loses value late and struggles in long fights after his combo, so go into each engage with a clear target.
Jayce.teamfight: Watch for the moment Jayce Q To the Skies!’s leap is down, then approach from the flank and use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer. Before engaging, choose an escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice and decide when to activate Renekton R Dominus, then get out after your combo.
Jayce.watch: When you see Jayce E Acceleration Gate, Jayce Q Shock Blast is coming soon, so sidestep out of its line. When Jayce has his hammer out, watch for the leap from Jayce Q To the Skies! and the knockback from Jayce E Thundering Blow. Jayce Q Shock Blast can’t be blocked with magic resistance, so farm while moving side to side.

Kayle.build: Withstand the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Kayle deals mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. If her healing offsets the damage from one combo, slot Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Kayle.combo: Your standard trade is to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, hitting a unit, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. For a kill opportunity, build Fury and use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Kayle.escape: Kayle has no dash, so close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice just after Kayle Q Radiant Blast is down or misses. Stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator before she can escape with the movement speed from Kayle W Celestial Blessing. Before engaging, choose a unit for the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to hit so you can recast it.
Kayle.fight: Close in with Renekton E Slice and Dice, stun with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, deal damage and heal with Renekton Q Cull the Meek, then disengage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If you have a kill opportunity, concentrate your damage into empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator.
Kayle.laning: Keep your Fury near half with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don't keep pushing the lane just to build Fury. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don't stand aggressively until both are back up.
Kayle.phase: Turn the lead you gain through mid game into towers and objectives.
Kayle.teamfight: Take a route to Kayle from the flank or outside vision so she has no time to attack from the backline. Coordinate with your team's crowd control to pin Kayle down with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and keep an escape route open for Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Kayle.watch: Kayle Q Radiant Blast slows and reduces armor and magic resistance, so dodge the direct hit before engaging. Kayle W Celestial Blessing heals and grants movement speed, while Kayle R Divine Judgment blocks damage. If Kayle R Divine Judgment is active, hold your damage instead of dumping it; pin her down with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then attack after her invulnerability ends.

Malphite.build: Withstand the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Malphite Q Seismic Shard, Malphite E Ground Slam, and Malphite R Unstoppable Force deal mostly magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Malphite has high armor, making physical damage less effective, so later consider armor penetration or damage that bypasses armor.
Malphite.combo: Your standard trade is Renekton E Slice and Dice engage → basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice disengage. If Malphite holds out with Malphite P Granite Shield active, build Fury, break the shield with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, land Renekton Q Cull the Meek and a basic attack, then back off.
Malphite.escape: Wait after being slowed by Malphite Q Seismic Shard, and when Malphite E Ground Slam is down, close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and use Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Before engaging, choose a unit for the first dash to hit so you can save the recast for disengaging.
Malphite.fight: Break Malphite P Granite Shield first, then engage with Fury after Malphite Q Seismic Shard or Malphite E Ground Slam is down. Hit a minion or Malphite with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to keep the recast available, pin him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then deal damage and heal with Renekton Q Cull the Meek. Use your abilities and escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice instead of staying in a prolonged fight.
Malphite.phase: Renekton should turn his lead through mid game into lane pressure and objectives.
Malphite.teamfight: Spread out from your team so Malphite R Unstoppable Force doesn't knock up several of you at once, and don't group up when you can't see Malphite's position. Counterattack just after his ultimate is used, with Renekton hitting an enemy carry from the flank with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Before engaging, plan Renekton E Slice and Dice's escape route and when to activate Renekton R Dominus.
Malphite.watch: If Malphite P Granite Shield is still up, your trades are less effective, so break it first. Don't engage right after being hit by Malphite Q Seismic Shard, since the slow makes it harder; go in after Malphite E Ground Slam is down. Malphite R Unstoppable Force can't be interrupted by a stun, so when you can't see his position, watch for angles through bushes and from behind walls.

Mordekaiser.build: Withstand Mordekaiser's main damage with a Null-Magic Mantle first, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If Mordekaiser W Indestructible's healing offsets your combo damage, slot Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Mordekaiser.combo: Your standard trade is to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, hitting a unit, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. For a kill opportunity, build Fury and use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice. After level 6, activate Renekton R Dominus just before engaging.
Mordekaiser.escape: Engaging just after Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down reduces the risk of being pulled in. Mordekaiser has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Hit a unit with the first dash to keep the recast available, then escape with it after your combo.
Mordekaiser.fight: When Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp is down and you have Fury, engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, deal damage, and disengage before Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates. If Mordekaiser W Indestructible's shield is active, break it with an empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, or focus your damage after the shield is depleted or converted into healing.
Mordekaiser.laning: Build Fury with minion last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don't push the lane too far. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don't stand aggressively until both are back up.
Mordekaiser.phase: Turn your lead by mid game, when your core items are coming online, into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton's value falls later, and you'll be at a disadvantage in a prolonged fight after your combo, so don't stay in an extended fight.
Mordekaiser.teamfight: Keep your team spaced out so Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp doesn't pull in several people at once. From the flank, Renekton should hit an enemy carry with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator and escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, plan both your escape setup and when to activate Renekton R Dominus.
Mordekaiser.watch: Keep your distance from the front so you aren't pulled in by Mordekaiser E Death's Grasp and hit by Mordekaiser Q Obliterate. Mordekaiser P Darkness Rise activates after three hits, so trade briefly and back off. When Mordekaiser R Realm of Death is available, don't enter its range alone expecting help from your team.

Nasus.build: Build armor first against Nasus Q Siphoning Strike, his main damage source. Armor won't block the magic damage from Nasus E Spirit Fire or Nasus R Fury of the Sands, so leave the area effect and avoid building only a large amount of health.
Nasus.combo: Hit Nasus or a minion with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to keep the recast available, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. For a kill opportunity, build Fury and use Renekton E Slice and Dice engage → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Nasus.escape: Nasus has no ability to create distance, so engage just after Nasus W Wither is down. Hit a unit with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to keep the recast available, pin him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then escape with the second dash.
Nasus.fight: Build Fury ahead of time with last hits and basic attacks. When Nasus W Wither is down, close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Don't continue fighting while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active unless you have a clear advantage.
Nasus.laning: Pressure Nasus early to deny him a safe place to stack Nasus Q Siphoning Strike. However, if you push the lane to Nasus's tower, he can last-hit safely, so build Fury mainly through last hits and let the lane come toward you. Use the fact that Nasus has no escape besides Flash to call your jungler for a gank.
Nasus.phase: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike stacks last forever, so turn your early lead into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton is strong through mid game but loses value later, while Nasus grows stronger over time.
Nasus.teamfight: Don't face Nasus head-on while Nasus R Fury of the Sands is active; keep your distance. Renekton should look to engage from the flank, hit an enemy carry with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice once the recast is available.
Nasus.watch: Nasus Q Siphoning Strike grows more threatening as its stacks build, so pressure him early and prevent easy last hits. Nasus W Wither reduces your movement and attack speed, so don't stay within Nasus's range alone for long. Nasus R Fury of the Sands greatly increases his health and defensive stats, so unless you have a clear advantage, back off and wait out its duration.

Olaf.build: Get Plated Steelcaps earlier against Olaf's physical damage. If trades keep going poorly, buy Chain Vest first; if the enemy team has several physical damage dealers, get armor and health with Randuin's Omen. Armor can't reduce the true damage from Olaf E Reckless Swing.
Olaf.combo: When Olaf R Ragnarok is down and he can't retrieve his axe, engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. If you have a chance to break Olaf W Tough It Out's shield or finish him, build Fury and use empowered W, followed by Q and a basic attack. Decide what to hit before engaging, since the first E must hit a unit for the second E to be available for escaping.
Olaf.escape: Olaf has no ability to create distance, so you can look to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice when Olaf Q Undertow is down and he can't retrieve his axe. If Olaf R Ragnarok is active, create distance and wait it out; stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator once it ends.
Olaf.fight: Build Fury ahead of time, then take a short trade when Olaf Q Undertow is down and he can't retrieve his axe. You can use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator against the shield from Olaf W Tough It Out, but don't engage expecting to stun him if Olaf R Ragnarok is active. Olaf gets stronger at low health, so don't stay in a prolonged fight after your combo.
Olaf.laning: Build Fury with minion last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don't push the lane too far. Move to the opposite side from where Olaf Q Undertow's axe lands. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don't stand aggressively until both are back up.
Olaf.phase: Renekton's value also falls sharply later, so don't let fights drag on.
Olaf.teamfight: While Olaf R Ragnarok is active, don't use the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator on him; create distance instead. Renekton's role is to flank, hit an enemy carry with empowered W, and escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, plan both your E escape setup and when to activate Renekton R Dominus.
Olaf.watch: Olaf Q Undertow slows and reduces armor, so move opposite the direction the axe lands to prevent him from retrieving it. Olaf E Reckless Swing deals true damage, so when your health is low, don't rely on armor; heal with Renekton Q Cull the Meek or create distance with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Renekton W Ruthless Predator's stun doesn't work during Olaf R Ragnarok, so don't fight him and wait for its duration to end.

Ornn.build: The reference material does not specify the first item to buy. Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and Ornn E Searing Charge deal physical damage, while Ornn W Bellows Breath and Ornn R Call of the Forge God deal magic damage, so avoid stacking resistance against only one damage type. Ornn W Bellows Breath deals damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about stacking health alone.
Ornn.combo: If Ornn's poke abilities are down, trade in this order: Renekton E Slice and Dice in → basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice out. When you have a kill opportunity, build Fury and deal your damage in this order: Renekton E Slice and Dice in → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Ornn.escape: Don't go in just because Ornn E Searing Charge is down; look for a window when Ornn R Call of the Forge God is also not yet back up. Then close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, making it difficult for Ornn to escape. If you're near a pillar from Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture or a wall, Ornn E Searing Charge can knock you up after you engage, so fight in an open area.
Ornn.fight: Build up nearly half your Fury, then take a short trade when Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture or Ornn W Bellows Breath is down. When engaging with Renekton E Slice and Dice, choose a unit to hit with the first dash so you have the recast for your escape. If Ornn still has a mobility ability available, don't overcommit to trying to kill him in one go.
Ornn.laning: After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don't stand aggressively until both abilities are back up.
Ornn.phase: Turn your lane pressure into objective control while Renekton is strong through the mid game. Renekton's value falls in long late-game fights, so get ahead before Ornn's items and his team's Masterwork upgrades stack up.
Ornn.teamfight: Dodge the spirit from Ornn R Call of the Forge God to the side, and move out of the line between Ornn and the spirit to prepare for Ornn's recast dash as well. Approach from the flank, land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key damage dealer, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, plan both which unit to hit with the first dash and when to activate Renekton R Dominus.
Ornn.watch: Move away from the pillar left by Ornn Q Volcanic Rupture and from walls to avoid the knockup from Ornn E Searing Charge. If the final burst of Ornn W Bellows Breath makes you brittle, don't advance; keep your distance until the effect ends.

Pantheon.build: Pantheon's main damage is physical, so build armor first and get Plated Steelcaps early. If you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first; if the enemy team has several physical damage dealers, build toward Randuin's Omen as well. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Pantheon.combo: Hit a minion or Pantheon with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to secure the recast, then trade and disengage in this order: basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice. For a kill opportunity, build Fury and use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is blocking the front, wait for it to end before dealing damage or change your angle to the side.
Pantheon.escape: When Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and the risk of being stunned is lower, close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice. The opportunity is even better if Pantheon R Grand Starfall is not back up; once you're on him, stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Before engaging, choose a unit to hit with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice so you have the recast to escape.
Pantheon.fight: Build Fury ahead of time and engage just after Pantheon's poke abilities are used. If Pantheon E Aegis Assault is active, stop attacking from the front and wait for it to end or change your angle with Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Pantheon.phase: Both champions have less impact late game, and Renekton falls behind if the fight drags on after his combo.
Pantheon.teamfight: Engage from the flank, land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, plan an escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice and when to activate Renekton R Dominus. If you see the landing indicator for Pantheon R Grand Starfall, walk out of its landing area.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault stuns a targeted enemy, so be careful before entering its range. Stand behind minions to reduce the damage you take from Pantheon Q Comet Spear poke. Pantheon E Aegis Assault blocks damage from the direction it faces, so don't attack from the front; wait for it to end or circle around to the side.

Poppy.build: Build armor first to prepare for Poppy's main damage from Poppy Q Hammer Shock, Poppy E Heroic Charge, and Poppy R Keeper's Verdict. Poppy Q Hammer Shock deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone. Poppy P Iron Ambassador and Poppy W Steadfast Presence deal little magic damage, so you don't need to buy magic resistance specifically for Poppy.
Poppy.combo: When Poppy W Steadfast Presence has ended and Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, hit a minion or Poppy with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to secure the recast. Then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek, and escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If you have Fury and a kill opportunity, deal damage in this order: empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack.
Poppy.escape: The moment after Poppy uses Poppy E Heroic Charge is your window to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active, it will stop your dash, so wait for its duration to end. Before going in, choose a unit to hit with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to secure an escape.
Poppy.fight: Build nearly half your Fury and start trading after Poppy W Steadfast Presence ends. If Poppy E Heroic Charge is down, close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. If you need sustain, spend Fury on an empowered Renekton Q Cull the Meek that hits both minions and Poppy; if you can finish her, spend it on empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator.
Poppy.laning: Stand in an open area to avoid being stunned against a wall by Poppy E Heroic Charge. When the shield from Poppy P Iron Ambassador drops, step on it first to prevent her from gaining the shield and prepare to trade.
Poppy.phase: Renekton's value falls late game, and he is weak in long fights after his combo, so don't let fights drag on.
Poppy.teamfight: Don't engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active. Approach from the flank, land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer, then escape with the Renekton E Slice and Dice recast you've secured. Before engaging, plan when to activate Renekton R Dominus and which route you'll use to escape.
Poppy.watch: Don't dash with Renekton E Slice and Dice while Poppy W Steadfast Presence is active; wait for it to end. Poppy E Heroic Charge stuns you if it knocks you into a wall, so don't stand with your back to one. If you're hit by the first strike of Poppy Q Hammer Shock, walk out of the zone before the second strike detonates. If you see Poppy charging Poppy R Keeper's Verdict, move from the front to the side.

Riven.build: All of Riven's damage is physical, so build armor first. Get Plated Steelcaps early, and if you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first. If the enemy team has several physical damage dealers, build toward Randuin's Omen to gain armor and health.
Riven.combo: If Riven Q Broken Wings is down, engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to escape. For a kill opportunity, build Fury and use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice. You must hit a unit with the first dash to use the second dash.
Riven.escape: Engage after Riven Q Broken Wings has been used to clear minions or she has spent her consecutive dashes. Check whether Riven E Valor is still available, since she can use it to escape. Also choose a unit to hit with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to secure your own escape.
Riven.fight: Build Fury and look for a moment when Riven Q Broken Wings is used to clear minions. If Riven jumps on you, interrupt her combo with Renekton W Ruthless Predator; use empowered W against the shield from Riven E Valor. After using your abilities, don't let the fight drag on.
Riven.laning: After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don't stand aggressively until both abilities are back up.
Riven.phase: Turn your advantage through mid game into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton's value falls late game, and he falls behind if the fight drags on after his combo, so fight briefly.
Riven.teamfight: Approach from the flank, land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, create distance with its increased range and execute damage in mind.
Riven.watch: Riven Q Broken Wings starts her combo with consecutive dashes and a knockup, so back away when you see the first dash. If Riven gets on you, stun her with Renekton W Ruthless Predator to interrupt her follow-up attacks. While Riven R Blade of the Exile is active, her range is increased and her finishing damage scales with missing health, making it dangerous, so create distance.

Rumble.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Rumble deals mostly magic damage, so prioritize magic resistance over armor or stacking health alone.
Rumble.combo: Your basic trade is Renekton E Slice and Dice in → basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice out. If you expect to lose the trade, skip the first basic attack and keep it short.
Rumble.escape: Rumble has no mobility, so when Rumble Q Flamespitter is down, get on him with Renekton E Slice and Dice and hold him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. If he has also used Rumble W Scrap Shield, engage when its shield and movement speed boost wear off. If you're hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, don't force the engage; escape with E before the second shot.
Rumble.fight: As soon as Rumble Q Flamespitter is down, secure Fury and make a short engage. If Rumble W Scrap Shield is active, briefly wait for the shield to disappear or break it with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator. After your combo, escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice and avoid a long fight.
Rumble.laning: Don't keep hitting minions to build Fury, since that pushes the lane. Before engaging with Renekton E Slice and Dice, choose a minion or Rumble to hit with the first dash so you have a way to recast it.
Rumble.phase: Turn your lane advantage through mid game into objectives and pressure. Renekton's value drops sharply late game, and he is weak in long fights after his combo, so make use of your early and mid-game opportunities.
Rumble.teamfight: Approach from the flank and land Renekton's empowered W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer instead of staying in front for a long time. Before engaging, plan an escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice and when to activate Renekton R Dominus; after your combo, escape with E.
Rumble.watch: Rumble Q Flamespitter and Rumble P Junkyard Titan deal magic damage based on your maximum health, so minimize the time you spend close to him. If you're hit by the first shot of Rumble E Electro Harpoon, create distance with Renekton E Slice and Dice before the second shot arrives. If both shots hit, the slow and magic resistance reduction increase the damage that follows.

Sett.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor to withstand Sett's basic attacks and Sett Q Knuckle Down. If you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first; if the enemy team has several physical damage dealers, build toward Randuin's Omen as well. Sett Q Knuckle Down deals damage based on your maximum health, and resistance doesn't reduce the center's true damage from Sett W Haymaker, so don't rely on stacking health alone.
Sett.combo: Your basic trade is Renekton E Slice and Dice in → basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice out. If Sett W Haymaker's retaliation is a concern, skip the first basic attack and keep it short.
Sett.escape: While Sett R The Show Stopper is down, close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and hold him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. If Sett E Facebreaker is also down, the risk of being stunned is lower. Before engaging, choose a unit to hit with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to secure the recast and an escape.
Sett.fight: Build nearly half your Fury, then engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice when Sett E Facebreaker is down. Stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator and deal damage while healing with Renekton Q Cull the Meek, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice before Sett W Haymaker gets stronger. If Sett survives with the shield from Sett W Haymaker, you can break it with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator.
Sett.laning: After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don't stand aggressively until both abilities are back up.
Sett.phase: Turn your advantage through mid game, as core items come online, into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton lacks sustained damage late game, so look for short engages and escapes instead of long fights.
Sett.teamfight: From the flank, check your escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice and activate Renekton R Dominus, then land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key enemy damage dealer. Watch the positions of your allies on both sides of Sett so Sett E Facebreaker doesn't stun you. Sett R The Show Stopper cannot be escaped with Flash once it grabs you, so consider where you'll be thrown when you engage.
