Sett.watch: Sett W Haymaker gets stronger right after he takes damage, so use your combo and create distance. If it's hard to dodge, sidestep the center of its aim to avoid the true damage. Sett E Facebreaker stuns when enemies are on both sides of him, so don't stand opposite Sett with minions between you and him.

Shen.build: Prioritize tenacity to prepare for the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash. Shen E Shadow Dash deals physical damage and Shen Q Twilight Assault deals magic damage, so don't focus on resistance to only one damage type. Shen Q Twilight Assault deals damage based on your maximum health, so avoid stacking health alone.
Shen.combo: After Shen E Shadow Dash misses and Shen W Spirit's Refuge ends, engage by hitting a unit with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to escape. If you have a kill opportunity, build Fury in advance and use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice after engaging. After level 6, activate Renekton R Dominus just before engaging.
Shen.escape: Shen E Shadow Dash is his only mobility ability and his hard crowd control, so the moment it misses is your window to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Hit a minion or Shen with the first dash to unlock the recast, then use the second dash to escape after the trade. Time your kill attempt with Shen R Stand United's return to availability in mind.
Shen.fight: Build nearly half your Fury, then engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice if Shen E Shadow Dash misses. If Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, wait on basic attacks and use Renekton Q Cull the Meek for damage and healing. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don't stand aggressively until both abilities are back up.
Shen.laning: If you keep hitting minions to build Fury, you'll push the lane, so watch for ganks. Once you have the advantage, keep Shen occupied with CS to increase the cost of leaving with Shen R Stand United; if he leaves, take advantage of the empty lane.
Shen.phase: Turn your advantage through mid game into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton's value falls late game, and he falls behind if the fight drags on after his combo, so fight briefly.
Shen.teamfight: Renekton should enter from the flank, land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a key damage dealer, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Alert your team if you see Shen channeling Shen R Stand United or if he disappears from lane, and judge whether you can finish the fight before he joins.
Shen.watch: If you get hit by the taunt from Shen E Shadow Dash, you're likely to take empowered basic attacks from Shen Q Twilight Assault. Dodge Shen E Shadow Dash, and also move out of the path of Shen's spirit blade as it returns to him. When Shen W Spirit's Refuge is active, stop basic attacking and engage again after the zone ends.

Singed.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Singed's main damage is magic, and Renekton tends to have low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Singed.combo: For a standard trade, dash in with Renekton E Slice and Dice, hitting a unit, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to escape. Your first dash must hit a unit to enable the recast, so choose an escape target before engaging.
Singed.escape: Engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice when Singed W Mega Adhesive is down and there is no adhesive underfoot. If Singed E Fling is also down, you have a chance to lock him down with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Singed has no skill that creates distance on his own, but check which way he is facing and the enemy formation behind him before you engage.
Singed.fight: Use Renekton P Reign of Anger to build Fury before trading, then engage as soon as Singed W Mega Adhesive or Singed E Fling is down. Close in with Renekton E Slice and Dice, stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then do not prolong the fight by following Singed Q Poison Trail. If you need sustain, use empowered Renekton Q Cull the Meek where it hits both minions and Singed.
Singed.laning: Keep your Fury near half with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but do not keep pushing the lane just to build Fury and expose yourself to ganks.
Singed.phase: Once Singed has his core items, he becomes harder to catch, and Renekton's value falls off in the late game, so avoid prolonged fights after your combo.
Singed.teamfight: Stun a charging Singed with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then attack his allies while he is occupied instead of chasing him to the end. Renekton's role is to flank and land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on an enemy carry, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, plan both the unit you will use to escape and when to activate Renekton R Dominus.
Singed.watch: Do not chase a low-health Singed through Singed Q Poison Trail. When Singed R Insanity Potion is active, his poison applies Grievous Wounds, so do not rely on Renekton Q Cull the Meek to heal through a prolonged fight. Renekton E Slice and Dice cannot be used on Singed W Mega Adhesive, and Singed E Fling roots you if it hits you there, so go around the adhesive.

Sion.build: Sion's main sources of damage—Sion P Glory in Death, Sion Q Decimating Smash, and Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught—deal physical damage, so build armor first. Sion W Soul Furnace and Sion E Roar of the Slayer deal magic damage and cannot be blocked with armor. Since Sion P Glory in Death deals damage based on max health, avoid choices that add a large amount of health alone.
Sion.combo: Before engaging, choose a unit for the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to hit so you can recast it. A standard trade is Renekton E Slice and Dice → basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice. If you have a kill opportunity while Sion W Soul Furnace is active, build Fury before engaging, then use empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Sion.escape: If Sion Q Decimating Smash has also just been used, stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator and trade. On the way in, hit a unit with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to keep the recast available for your escape.
Sion.fight: Engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice as soon as Sion Q Decimating Smash is down, with Fury ready. When Sion activates Sion W Soul Furnace, break the shield with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator and unload your damage. After trading, escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice and do not stand aggressively until your abilities are back.
Sion.laning: If you keep giving Sion CS, his max health grows permanently, so push the lane to disrupt his farming or create an advantage elsewhere on the map.
Sion.phase: Carry your lead through mid game into lane pressure and objective fights. Renekton's value falls off late, while Sion's max health grows as he farms, so do not let the game drag on.
Sion.teamfight: Renekton should flank and land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on an enemy carry, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice instead of staying in front for a long time. Before engaging, plan your escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice and when to activate Renekton R Dominus. If you take Sion down, reposition instead of fighting in place until Sion P Glory in Death ends.
Sion.watch: When Sion charges Sion Q Decimating Smash, move around to the side to avoid its slow, stun, and knockup. Sion R Unstoppable Onslaught charges in a straight line, so avoid narrow paths and sidestep it. After taking Sion down, reposition to avoid Sion P Glory in Death's rapid attacks and max-health-based damage.

Skarner.build: Skarner's main damage is magic, and Renekton tends to have low magic resistance, so buy Null-Magic Mantle first and build magic resistance. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Skarner P Threads of Vibration and Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval scale with max health, so be cautious about choices that add a large amount of health alone.
Skarner.combo: A standard trade is Renekton E Slice and Dice in → basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice out. When you have a kill opportunity, build Fury and use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Skarner.escape: The window to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice opens as soon as Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down. Hit a minion or Skarner with the first dash to enable the recast, lock him down with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then escape with the recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Skarner R Impale has already caught you, a dash cannot remove the suppression.
Skarner.fight: Approach with Renekton E Slice and Dice as soon as Skarner E Ixtal's Impact is down, with Fury ready. Lock him down with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, deal damage and heal with Renekton Q Cull the Meek, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Skarner W Seismic Bastion's shield is up, take advantage of empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator breaking it.
Skarner.laning: Do not stand with your back to a wall so you can dodge Skarner E Ixtal's Impact, and start a trade after Skarner's poke ability is down. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, do not stand aggressively until both abilities are back.
Skarner.phase: Carry your mid-game lead into lane pressure and objectives to delay Skarner's tank items. Renekton's value falls off late, and he is weak in long fights after his combo, so do not let your early lead slip.
Skarner.teamfight: Keep your distance from Skarner and his allies, mindful of Skarner R Impale's short range, and do not stand close to the edges of the dragon or Baron pit. Plan when to activate Renekton R Dominus and choose an escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice, then flank and land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on an enemy carry. After your combo, escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Skarner.watch: Skarner E Ixtal's Impact passes through terrain and stuns its target upon collision with a wall, so do not stand with your back to one. Skarner Q Shattered Earth/Upheaval's empowered attack and Skarner P Threads of Vibration become more dangerous the longer you fight up close, so avoid extended trades. Skarner R Impale's suppression cannot be removed with Renekton W Ruthless Predator's stun or Renekton E Slice and Dice's dash, so keep your distance before he catches you.

TahmKench.build: Since Tahm Kench's main damage is magic, buy Null-Magic Mantle early and build magic resistance first. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If the healing from Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash and Tahm Kench E Thick Skin turns trades around, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
TahmKench.combo: Before engaging, choose a minion or Tahm Kench for the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to hit so you can recast it. A standard trade is Renekton E Slice and Dice in → basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice out. When you have an opening to finish him, build Fury and unload damage with Renekton E Slice and Dice in → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
TahmKench.escape: Once Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, he has trouble engaging or escaping, so close the distance with Renekton E Slice and Dice then. The moment after Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash is down is also a chance to trade. If Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste has two stacks on you, do not engage; back away and wait for them to disappear.
TahmKench.fight: Tahm Kench E Thick Skin converts damage into a shield or healing, so look for fights where you build Fury and unload your damage at once instead of trading small hits. After Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive is down, close in with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. If you need sustain, spend Fury on empowered Renekton Q Cull the Meek where it hits both minions and Tahm Kench.
TahmKench.laning: After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, do not stand aggressively until both abilities are back.
TahmKench.phase: Use your strength through mid game, when your core items come online, to create lane pressure and objective advantages. Renekton's value falls off sharply late, and he loses prolonged fights after his combo, so build your lead in the early and mid game.
TahmKench.teamfight: If you see Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, spread out from your allies so several of you do not get knocked up. Rather than sticking to Tahm Kench for a long time, Renekton should flank and land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on a carry, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Tahm Kench R Devour is ready, account for the possibility that he can swallow a carry, make them untargetable, and grant them a shield when they are spat out before you try to finish them.
TahmKench.watch: When Tahm Kench P An Acquired Taste reaches three stacks from basic attacks and Tahm Kench Q Tongue Lash, he has an opening to stun and devour you. If you have been hit twice, move out of range and wait for the stacks to disappear. When you see the animation for Tahm Kench W Abyssal Dive, its landing point briefly disappears from view, so spread out from allies to avoid the area knockup.

Teemo.build: Early on, buy Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Teemo's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Teemo.combo: When Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, build Fury, engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then fight with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice. Your first Renekton E Slice and Dice must hit a unit to enable the recast, so choose a target to hit and an escape route before engaging.
Teemo.escape: The moment after Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down is your chance to engage. Watch for Teemo W Move Quick creating distance, then close in with Renekton E Slice and Dice and catch him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. While blinded, do not attempt basic attacks; deal damage with abilities or back away.
Teemo.fight: As soon as Teemo Q Blinding Dart is down, close the distance with Renekton E Slice and Dice with Fury ready, then stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. After trading, do not stand aggressively until Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice are available again.
Teemo.phase: Turn your early lead into lane pressure and objectives to leave Teemo less time to plant mushrooms. Renekton's value falls off late, and Teemo R Noxious Trap stays around for a long time, so check key paths as you move.
Teemo.teamfight: Use Oracle Lens to clear Teemo R Noxious Trap near objectives and in narrow passages. Renekton should flank and land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on an enemy carry, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Teemo.watch: Teemo Q Blinding Dart negates basic attacks, so if you are hit, do not rush to use basic attacks or Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Teemo E Toxic Shot applies damage over time even with one basic attack, so stay out of range unless you are ready to engage. Also watch for Teemo P Guerrilla Warfare in brush you have no vision of and Teemo R Noxious Trap along key paths.

Tryndamere.build: Since Tryndamere's main damage is physical and critical strikes, buy Plated Steelcaps earlier, and build armor with Chain Vest if you keep losing trades. If the enemy team has several physical damage dealers, build toward Randuin's Omen as well. If Tryndamere Q Bloodlust's healing cancels out your combo damage, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Tryndamere.combo: When Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is down, engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, hitting a unit, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → recast E to escape. When you have a kill opportunity, build Fury and focus your damage with E engage → empowered W → Q → basic attack → E.
Tryndamere.escape: The moment after you bait out Tryndamere E Spinning Slash is your window to engage; close the distance with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator. After Tryndamere W Mocking Shout has been used is also a good time to engage. When backing away, walk backward while facing Tryndamere to avoid W's slow, and if the first dash of Renekton E hit a unit, recast it to escape.
Tryndamere.fight: Build Fury to around half, then use Renekton E Slice and Dice to engage for a short trade the moment Tryndamere E Spinning Slash has been used. Lock him down with Renekton W Ruthless Predator and hit him with Renekton Q Cull the Meek, then escape with the E recast and avoid an extended basic-attack fight. If you have an opening to kill him, spend Fury on empowered W; if you need sustain, spend it on empowered Q.
Tryndamere.laning: Build Fury with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but do not push the lane too far. Use Q where it can hit both your opponent and minions to get the healing.
Tryndamere.phase: Carry the lead you build through mid game, when your core items come online, into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton's value falls off late and he loses extended fights after his combo, so do not keep fighting Tryndamere for long periods.
Tryndamere.teamfight: After planning an escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice and when to activate Renekton R Dominus, Renekton should land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on an enemy carry and escape. If Tryndamere's R is ready and he is pushing a side lane, do not go alone to stop him; trade for an objective or send more players.
Tryndamere.watch: Tryndamere P Battle Fury's critical strikes and Tryndamere Q Bloodlust's healing become more threatening as his Fury builds, so create distance when he starts attacking minions to build Fury. When Tryndamere R Undying Rage is active, stop dealing more damage; lock him down with Renekton W Ruthless Predator or create distance with Renekton E Slice and Dice to run out the duration.

Udyr.build: Build armor first against Udyr’s main damage. Udyr Q Wilding Claw deals both physical and magic damage, while Udyr R Wingborne Storm deals magic damage, so armor alone won’t block all of it. If healing from Udyr W Iron Mantle negates your short-combo damage, fit Executioner's Calling between core items.
Udyr.combo: Hit a minion or Udyr with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to unlock its recast, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → recast E to escape. If you have a kill opportunity while Udyr is shielded by W Iron Mantle, build Fury and break the shield with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then use Q and basic attacks while he’s stunned.
Udyr.escape: Engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice right after drawing out Udyr E Blazing Stampede, and secure the recast for your escape. Immobilizing effects don’t work while Udyr E Blazing Stampede is empowered, so use the stun from Renekton W Ruthless Predator after the empowerment ends. When disengaging from Udyr, don’t try to run away on foot; save E or W.
Udyr.fight: Right after Udyr uses E Blazing Stampede is your chance to close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice. If Udyr E Blazing Stampede has already stunned you, take a short trade during the window when it can’t stun the same target again. Once the shield from Udyr W Iron Mantle falls off, press your attack without giving him time to heal.
Udyr.laning: Udyr can appear from the jungle to gank, so secure vision at key paths and jungle entrances, and don’t push forward when you can’t see where he is. Renekton should build Fury with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek without pushing the lane too far. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don’t stand aggressively until both are available again.
Udyr.phase: Turn the lead you gain by midgame into lane pressure and objectives, and account for your weaker extended fights after your combo and your drop-off late game.
Udyr.teamfight: Don’t try to burst down Udyr first when he has defensive items and Udyr W Iron Mantle; target a weaker enemy behind him instead. Decide when to activate Renekton R Dominus and choose a unit to serve as your escape setup for Renekton E Slice and Dice, then approach from the side, hit a main damage dealer with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, and get out. Don’t rely on the W stun to engage before Udyr E Blazing Stampede’s empowerment ends.
Udyr.watch: Udyr E Blazing Stampede quickly closes the gap and stuns, so keep your distance right after he activates a stance. Udyr Q Wilding Claw and Udyr R Wingborne Storm deal damage based on your max health, and R also slows you, making extended fights unfavorable.

Urgot.build: Build armor first against Urgot's main damage and buy Plated Steelcaps earlier. If you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first to stay alive. Since Urgot P Echoing Flames scales with max health, avoid choices that only add health.
Urgot.combo: If Urgot E Disdain is down and your Fury is ready, engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice and trade with basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice. If you expect to lose the trade, skip the first basic attack after engaging and cut it short with Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Urgot.escape: Urgot E Disdain is his only mobility skill, so the moment after you bait it out is your window to engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Go in and stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, but if Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits and his fire focuses on you, escape out of range with Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Urgot.fight: Engage briefly with Fury ready as soon as Urgot E Disdain is down. Stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator, deal damage and heal with Renekton Q Cull the Meek, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Do not let the fight drag on near Urgot.
Urgot.laning: After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, do not stand aggressively until both abilities are back.
Urgot.phase: Turn Renekton's lead through mid game into lane and objective pressure, and avoid prolonged fights given that his value falls off late.
Urgot.teamfight: Urgot E Disdain stops at the first champion it hits, so stand with your frontline to reduce the chance of a carry behind you getting pulled out. Renekton should flank and land empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator on an enemy carry, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, plan your escape target for Renekton E Slice and Dice and when to use Renekton R Dominus.
Urgot.watch: Urgot P Echoing Flames deals damage based on max health, so do not stay near Urgot for long. If Urgot Q Corrosive Charge hits you, you are slowed and Urgot W Purge focuses its fire on you, so decide whether to escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice as the incoming attack flies toward you. If Urgot R Fear Beyond Death hits you, get completely out of range before reaching the execute line.

Volibear.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Volibear Q Thundering Smash, W Frenzied Maul, and R Stormbringer. If healing from Volibear W Frenzied Maul negates your short-combo damage, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Volibear.combo: For a short trade, dash in with E Slice and Dice by hitting a unit, then use basic attack → W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Q Cull the Meek, and disengage with E Slice and Dice. If the trade looks unfavorable, skip the first basic attack and keep it brief. For a kill, build Fury, then use E Slice and Dice → empowered W Ruthless Predator → Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → E Slice and Dice.
Volibear.escape: Look for an opening to engage after dodging or drawing out Volibear Q Thundering Smash. If Volibear can still use R Stormbringer, don’t chase just because Q Thundering Smash is down. Before Volibear R Stormbringer comes back up, close the gap with E Slice and Dice and stun him with W Ruthless Predator to limit his chance to escape.
Volibear.fight: Build up Fury in advance, then make a short trade right after dodging Volibear E Sky Splitter. Don’t let the fight drag on after your combo because Volibear W Frenzied Maul heals him. When you can finish him, stun him with empowered W Ruthless Predator and burst him down. Use empowered W Ruthless Predator when he tries to hold out with the shield from Volibear E Sky Splitter, too.
Volibear.laning: Use Q Cull the Meek where it can hit both minions and Volibear to secure healing. After using W Ruthless Predator and E Slice and Dice, don’t stand aggressively until they’re available again.
Volibear.phase: Turn the lead you gain through midgame into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton’s value falls off late, and he is at a disadvantage in extended fights after his combo, so keep fights short.
Volibear.teamfight: If Volibear has built stacks of P The Relentless Storm by attacking minions or monsters, don’t fight him right away; engage after the stacks fall off. Renekton should approach from the side, hit the enemy’s main damage dealer with empowered W Ruthless Predator, then escape with E Slice and Dice. If Volibear R Stormbringer is available, don’t stay under your turret at low health; retreat deep inside.
Volibear.watch: Volibear Q Thundering Smash speeds up his approach and stuns, so keep out of his basic attack range and let time pass while it is active. When you see the mark from Volibear E Sky Splitter, sidestep to avoid its damage and slow, and watch which way he enters to receive the shield. Volibear W Frenzied Maul can heal him, so don’t stay in a prolonged fight with a Volibear whose health has decreased unless you have an opening to finish him.

Yasuo.build: Get Plated Steelcaps early and build armor against the physical damage from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath. If you keep losing trades, buy Chain Vest first; if the enemy team has several physical damage dealers, build it into Randuin's Omen. Armor doesn’t block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: Build Fury and engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice, then attack with empowered W Ruthless Predator → Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → E Slice and Dice, and disengage. Empowered W Ruthless Predator can break the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer. Your first E Slice and Dice can be recast only if it hits a unit, so choose your target before engaging.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, his Q Steel Tempest stacks reset, so close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and stun him with W Ruthless Predator. Don’t engage just because Yasuo has used E Sweeping Blade once; look for a chance to apply crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. When you go in, also secure a way out with the recast of Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Yasuo.fight: Build Fury to around half, then look for an opening as soon as Yasuo’s tornado is down. Strip the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with light poke first, or trade into the shield with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, which can break it. After using Renekton W Ruthless Predator and Renekton E Slice and Dice, don’t stand aggressively until both are available again.
Yasuo.laning: Build Fury with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don’t keep hitting minions and pushing the lane. Keeping a thin wave on your side reduces the number of minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use and makes it easier to stop him from approaching. Use Renekton Q Cull the Meek where it can hit both Yasuo and minions to get healing and Fury.
Yasuo.phase: Turn the lead you gain through midgame into lane pressure and objectives. Renekton’s value falls off late, and you are at a disadvantage when fights drag on after your combo, so keep fights short.
Yasuo.teamfight: Renekton should approach from the side, hit the enemy’s main damage dealer with empowered W Ruthless Predator, then escape with E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, plan a target to use as a stepping stone for your escape with E Slice and Dice and when to activate R Dominus. If the enemy frontline is too strong, don’t force your way through; target the backline.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest has a narrow hitbox, so move sideways to dodge when he approaches. After Yasuo lands Q Steel Tempest twice in a row, watch for the next tornado and engage right after he uses it. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use minions to close the gap, so watch their positions too.

Yone.build: There are no specific items listed to buy first, so a purchase order can’t be set. If choosing defensive stats, account for both Yone’s physical and magic damage, and consider movement speed to leave the marked attack area and attack speed reduction to slow the cycle of Yone Q Mortal Steel.
Yone.combo: When Yone’s tornado Q stacks disappear, engage by hitting a unit with the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → recast E to disengage.
Yone.escape: When Yone’s tornado Q stacks disappear and Yone E Soul Unbound or R Fate Sealed is down, close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Don’t rush in just because one of Yone’s mobility abilities is down; he can still escape with the other. Before going in, choose a unit for the first dash of E to hit, securing its recast as an escape.
Yone.fight: Build Fury to around half, then make a short trade after Yone’s tornado Q stacks disappear. If Yone dives in with E Soul Unbound, stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator to stop his return. Don’t let the fight drag on after using your abilities; escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice.
Yone.laning: Don’t keep hitting minions and pushing the lane, exposing yourself to ganks.
Yone.phase: Renekton’s value falls off late, and he is at a disadvantage in extended fights after his combo, so make the most of your early and midgame opportunities.
Yone.teamfight: Spread out from your allies so Yone W Spirit Cleave can’t hit several champions at once and grant him a large shield. Check your formation against Yone R Fate Sealed and whether you’re standing furthest back. Renekton should approach from the side, hit the main damage dealer with empowered W Ruthless Predator, then escape using the E Slice and Dice recast secured before engaging.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Yone Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare his tornado, stay out of range until the stacks disappear. After Yone engages with E Soul Unbound, he deals additional damage when he returns, so heal with Renekton Q Cull the Meek or create distance before health drops. Yone R Fate Sealed pulls in enemies along its path, so don’t line up with your allies in teamfights.

Yorick.build: Yorick Q Last Rites and Mist Walkers’ attacks deal physical damage, so build armor first. Be careful about choosing to stack health alone, given the max-health-based damage from Yorick E Mourning Mist and Yorick R Eulogy of the Isles. If healing from Yorick Q Last Rites negates your combo damage, buy Executioner's Calling between core items.
Yorick.combo: Engage with Renekton E Slice and Dice by hitting a unit, then use basic attack → Renekton W Ruthless Predator → basic attack → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → Renekton E Slice and Dice to disengage. If you can secure a kill, build Fury, then use Renekton E Slice and Dice → empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator → Renekton Q Cull the Meek → basic attack → Renekton E Slice and Dice. After level 6, activate Renekton R Dominus just before engaging.
Yorick.escape: Engage after dodging Yorick E Mourning Mist or when Yorick W Dark Procession is down. Yorick has no mobility ability, so close the gap with Renekton E Slice and Dice and land Renekton W Ruthless Predator. Before going in, choose a unit for the first dash of Renekton E Slice and Dice to hit, securing its recast and your escape route.
Yorick.fight: Build Fury in advance, then close in with Renekton E Slice and Dice right after Yorick E Mourning Mist is down. Yorick has no mobility ability, so stun him with Renekton W Ruthless Predator and deal damage, then get out before the fight drags on. Don’t start a fight where there are many graves and Mist Walkers.
Yorick.laning: Build Fury with last hits and Renekton Q Cull the Meek, but don’t keep hitting the lane and expose yourself to ganks. Also look for chances to push so Yorick can’t clear minions and build graves on his side.
Yorick.phase: Fights become unfavorable if they drag on after your combo, and your value falls off late, so convert your early and midgame lead into objectives and lane pressure. Late game, match Yorick’s side lane pressure while also judging when to trade for objectives elsewhere.
Yorick.teamfight: Renekton should approach from the side, hit the enemy’s main damage dealer with empowered Renekton W Ruthless Predator, then escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice. Before engaging, plan a target to use as a stepping stone for your escape with Renekton E Slice and Dice and when to activate Renekton R Dominus. If Yorick’s Mist Walkers and Maiden of the Mist are involved in the fight, clear them first; when a mark from the Maiden of the Mist is applied, create distance from Yorick himself.
Yorick.watch: Yorick E Mourning Mist slows, marks, and deals damage based on your max health, so avoid the orb’s trajectory to keep it from hitting you. If you’re trapped by Yorick W Dark Procession, break the wall by attacking it or cross it with Renekton E Slice and Dice. When the Maiden of the Mist starts marking you, create distance from Yorick himself.
